horoscopes.horoscope: Ganesha predicts that today you will look up to your family for happiness. Towards the later part of the day, however, there are possibilities of a platonic affair blossoming. Those who are already caught up in a romantic affair, says Ganesha, will experience some thrilling times. You need to be more careful and sensitive to the words you are expressing to your partner. The more candy-coated your words, the sweeter will be your love life. You will eventually experience what causes your sweetheart angry or what makes her delighted, feels Ganesha. Ganesha says that today you will be able to easily accomplish both mentally and physically challenging tasks. In a good mood since morning, you shall interact a lot with everyone in the professional realm. But, refrain from debating with anyone. Today you shall be worried about your long-term finances. These worries my be unfounded as your stars will favour you, and your commercial instincts happen to be fairly good. Whenever you are confused, don’t hesitate to ask for help. Your superiors will be more than happy to come to your aid. Your energy, confidence, and commitment will help you achieve your goal. People around you will appreciate your learning spirit, says Ganesha.

Ganesha sees you preferring your outer appearance, having a good time over getting internally organized. You will seek your comfort level from creature comforts, not from within. You are due to spend most of the day, dressed in your best and going out to your favourite haunts for good food and company. Going for a refreshing change, and dining out at some fashionable restaurant is very much in the cards. Tonight you might turn practical yet emotional in front of your loved one. You are likely to engage in a career related discussion. Your commitment to your sweetheart will be praiseworthy. A pleasurable evening is surely on the cards, sees Ganesha. Although you will be in the pink of health on this wonderful day, you should try your best to remain composed and control your anger at all costs. This shall enable you to utilise your energy for fruitful activities. Today you will be adept at bargaining when you have to purchase something, be it for your office or for your home. However, Ganesha advises you to first decide whether the expense if fully justified. Your confidence will be your trump card today but Ganesha feels that you tend to lose confidence as the evening approaches. Change in your lifestyle will boost your energy and mental spirit. Read some inspiring books to gain clarity of thought.

You will be able to improve your social standing and status tremendously today. You will spend all your energies in making your heart’s desires come true. You may end up proposing to that special someone and will find your life partner. You may finally decide to take the decision to tie the knot and settle down, says Ganesha. Flirting with your lover is on the cards, foresees Ganesha. Emotions run deep. You may spend a magical night with your sweetheart. Remain cautious. Avoid being desperate with your loved one, warns Ganesha. Your sense of humour will develop a better relationship. This day is ideal to note down your thoughts and prepare a plan for important activities related to your job or business. Try to get suggestions from your juniors and advice from your seniors. Don’t think too much – just act. Ganesha feels that you are likely to face major money expenses during the day. You will be spending money on things that are not essential for you. Ganesha suggests you not to spend on unnecessary things. You may be indecisive in the morning. Lack of focus may jeopardise your work in the first half. It will be only some time later in the afternoon that you will be able to gather your focus at work. Use more logic in your thinking and see where the day takes you.

Though the day will spring a lot of challenges, you will be up to it every single time. Your mind will be sharp, and will run like an athlete taking part in a marathon. All you need is a little self-belief. And there will be no stopping you once you set your mind free. You may experiment with the interiors of your house. Ganesha doesn’t foresee much comfort in your personal life. Chances are that you may be hiding something from your lover or may not like to disclose. You are likely to feel hurt if your partner raises doubts about your integrity. Learn to be loyal and committed, suggests Ganesha. Ganesha observes that after midday, you may feel very anxious due to some issues on the financial front. To overcome this stressful situation, you need to take a break to refresh yourself. Then, with a cool mind, find appropriate solutions. You are likely to make some financial gains during the day. Take a print out of pending payments and start following them up. You will surely receive an encouraging response from them. Today’s astral configuration is going to make you take chances with your luck. Avoid wasting time after fruitless pursuits post noon. Try to be analytical and manage your work better. You will get confident in your task after the evening, says Ganesha.

You will think of decorating or renovating your house today. You will likely buy some new decorative articles for your house today. You will take a huge business related or financial risk today but due to Ganesha’s blessings it will transform into substantial gain for you. Feel safe and proud on the arm of your lover. You will be able to express your desire freely to your loved one. You will get ready to fulfill your desire with your darling and this will surely cheer you up, feels Ganesha. Ganesha says that the planets shall be in favour of your health today. Subsequently, your energy level will soar. The best way to make the most of this fabulous day is to channelise your mind and body in the right direction. If you are willing to start a new project or if you wish to take up a new assignment which can be financially beneficial, you should do it in the first half of the day, suggests Ganesha. Troubleshooting is the key to success. The day will find you busy at your workplace. You will be in charge of solving complex problems. Find solutions to perplexing technical errors by using your logic, suggests Ganesha. You will quickly solve the important issue at the end of the day.

You will look up to your family to put you in high spirits, says Ganesha, However, you will have to loosen your purse strings and blow up some money on them to win their appreciation. Later in the evening you may start writing an account of a platonic affair. Giving a cold shoulder to your lover isn’t going to work in your favor, says Ganesha. Bonding will get stronger when you try to understand the complex mind of your loved one. Talk about your feelings and promise that you won’t let him or her down, advises Ganesha. Today your power of concentration may decrease after midday. Hence, avoid taking major decisions related to your personal and professional life. If you are working on a new project, move ahead with total clarity of mind. Don’t take any risk. Ganesha feels that you will not be much worried about money matters. Things will go as per your planning and there will hardly be any major up and down in your financial situation. You will be more analytical today and successfully attract faster progress at work. Today’s celestial energies will bless you with logical powers, which you can use to solve complex problems at the workplace. You can also do some R&D, says Ganesha.

The ghosts of ‘old lovers past’ are in the air. There is every possibility that you might end up reliving an old romantic affair; maybe even get treated to your heart’s content by your soul mate. Everything is possible in love. The afternoon may bring with it mixed fortunes. But remember to put on your party hat in the evening. Being a special invitee to a stag party with your mates is always fun. Go have a riot, says Ganesha. With love being the first thing on your mind, you will call it a day sooner than usual and rush into the arms of your companion. You will be busy in satisfying all the needs of your lover, feels Ganesha. On this very dull day, your health may deteriorate. Your energy level may dip – so take extra care of yourself, else you may fall ill. Those who are middle-aged and above must go for a routine medical check-up to remain fit. You should take good care of your health so that you don’t have to spend money on your bad health. Besides, your past investments may not appreciate much during the day says Ganesha. Today’s planetary energies will give you that extra dexterity to solve tough problems. Your mental energy seems to be very strong today. You can get along with anybody at your office. Everyone will find your advice very valuable, feels Ganesha.

The company of like-minded people will keep you in cheery spirit throughout the day. The day promises to be lively and vibrant as you will engage in one activity after another. But Ganesha warns that being over enthusiastic may be detrimental to your health. You energy level will be at an all-time high as you enjoy soaring to new heights in the company of loved ones. “Take me to your heart, take me to your soul” from Michael Learns to Rock will give you mental peace and relaxation. Yes, it’s a good day especially if you want to enjoy true blue romance which will help ease your worries, says Ganesha. Get ready to spend an evening to remember with your loved one. Today you will have to try hard to stay focussed on your tasks. You are suggested to maintain a very good rapport with your family members and colleagues as when you are down, only near ones and dear ones can cheer you up. During the latter half of the day, you may find yourself slowing down on expenses. You will become calculative and alert. So, if you go on shopping during the second half, you may spend less. Your attitude may need a bit a tweaking on the professional front especially today. There may be some disagreement with your superior regarding certain things. Many complex issues may delay your work or decision making. Ganesha says that you should be ready to adjust and compromise today.

Immersed in a pool of thoughts, you are busy in the mood of introspection today. Besides this, you are on a creative high and may think of giving your lovely abode, a makeover. Doing up the interiors will take up most of your time. At work, your superiors are in awe of you due to your commendable efforts, says Ganesha. A desire to establish a spiritual connection with your loved one will be at the top of your mind. Gospel music or an inspirational movie may help both of you get closer to each other. You may re-discover the soul of your lover, feels Ganesha. In the first half of the day, something will keep upsetting you and make you uncomfortable. As stress level is going to increase, you will have to learn to handle it. In the second half of the day, you will feel low energy. Delay in financial gains are foreseen today but patience will surely work wonders. Do not follow up for payments, but just maintain good terms with those who owe you money. Today, you will play a friend, philosopher, and guide to all and sundry, and will be particularly liberal with your unsolicited advice. However, your focus on work will not deviate. You will be able to create a positive aura around your work, feels Ganesha.

You are performing a tightrope walk and Ganesha congratulates you for rightly balancing the your personal and professional life both. Your hands will be full with assignments, projects, and domestic demands, and multitasking is the only way to handle everything together. You may feel negative from within but you will not let that emotion come on your face, feels Ganesha. Cheers! You will most probably win some sweet compliments from your loved one today, foresees Ganesha. The incredible way in which you’ll express your love to your sweetheart will impress him/her, feels Ganesha. The ultimate result will live on in your heart. While your day may start on a very positive note, as the day progresses, you will find your mind working on various aspects of life. Rule of energy is – more focussed it is, more impact it can create. Ensure that energies are not diverted. If you need to take a financial decision in the second half of the day, it is advisable to seek someone’s guidance or take someone’s view on the matter, as per Ganesha’s advice. It’s the right day to learn new things about your personal and professional life. You will need to manage your tasks a better way to bring progress. You need to go through some challenges initially. You may, however, turn experimental and creative to implement the best strategy.

The day begins on a dull note which may disturb and disappoint you. But, all is not wrong as you will receive some unexpected good news by the end of the first half of the day. It may become difficult for you to complete the work before deadlines and maintain the quality of output both, predicts Ganesha, so learn the art of time management. You will be the best person to know your sweetheart. The innovative ways in which you will express your love to your sweetheart will add bliss to your personal life. Domestic works will ease as both of you are likely to take responsibilities. Till midday, you shall be brimming with energy and enthusiasm. However, as the day descends, you may wish to do something different and creative. Go for a walk in the evening, or do some light exercises at home to refresh yourself. This day is good for the purchase of any item that can add to your luxury and comfort. You can even think of buying some expensive articles for your house or office, says Ganesha. Your ideas can get million dollar worth today. Your energy to find creative solutions to professional problems will come to the fore today. You will see faster progress in meetings or workshops. Stars are in your favour in the second half of the day.

You will harbour feelings of attraction towards those of the opposite sex, and are also likely to benefit from them. You will find lady luck favouring you. Post afternoon should see you struggling with a tough decision. Overall, the day ought to be routine, with nothing exceptional lurking to surprise you, says Ganesha. You have to compromise, says Ganesha. Else you may not be able to strengthen ties with your loved one. Manage your emotions carefully. Support your sweetheart. He or she might be able to solve most of your issues if you co-operate, advises Ganesha. Overall, this is going to be an average day. Although, you shall maintain good health, avoid wasting your energy after fruitless activities. Some adamant people in your workplace may disagree with your opinion. Do not get upset, just ignore them. Today, you will not be money minded at all. You will feel free to spend and free to save too. So, there will be two shades of the day, when it comes to money. You will be in a rather subdued mood today, says Ganesha. You may not feel confident or you are just not in the right frame of mind to handle important tasks at work. It’s best to avoid them, suggests Ganesha.
